# stb_image

`stb_image.h` is stb_image v2.30 from nothings/stb commit
`2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`:
https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20/stb_image.h

The complete upstream MIT/public-domain dual license is included at the end
of the header. This project compiles only its PNG decoder.
